description: State, County and City FIPS Reference Table is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. State, County and City FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) codes are a set of numeric designations given to state, cities and counties by the U.S. federal government. All geographic data submitted to the FRA must have a FIPS code. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 9 columns, among them State FIPS Code, City Code, County Name, StCntyCity FIPS Code, StCnty FIPS Code, County Code. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
